explanation: It is 0 everywhere except at D2 on a rare transition after choosing a2 (reaching S1), where it is usually 9-10, regardless of reward, previous trials or how many rare transitions came before. Rare transitions after choosing a1 (reaching S2), all common transitions, and every D1 and GO step stay at 0; very late in the episode (around trial 85 and later) the a2-to-S1 spike can be weak (0-2).
